IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Natural Resources, Ocean & Recreation.

Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing department of fish and wildlife employees to partake in certain inspections and samplings.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to inspections and sampling of fish, wildlife, andshellfish by department of fish and wildlife employees; amending RCW77.15.360; adding a new section to chapter 77.12 RCW; creating a newsection; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends that inspections offacilities and vessels and sampling of fish, wildlife, and shellfish bydepartment of fish and wildlife employees will ensure the conservationand management of fish, shellfish, and wildlife. Because the harvestof fish and wildlife is regulated by the department of fish andwildlife, the legislature finds that inspections and sampling bydepartmental employees will benefit the resource. The legislaturefurther finds that inspection and sampling will further the departmentof fish and wildlife's research related to fish, wildlife, andshellfish.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Department employees, in carrying out their duties under thistitle, may: (1) Inspect all fish, wildlife, and shellfish taken or possessed inthe field or state waters; (2) Inspect at a reasonable time and in a reasonable manner fish,wildlife, and shellfish stored at a processing plant or locker plant orother facility open for commercial purposes; (3) Collect samples of tissue, fluids, or other bodily parts offish, wildlife, or shellfish; (4) Board vessels in state waters engaged in commercial harvestactivities to inspect fish or shellfish, harvesting gear or devices, orharvest record data; or (5) Board and remain for a reasonable time as observers on boardvessels that are engaged in commercial harvest operations of fish orshellfish.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.15.360 and 2000 c 107 s 243 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of unlawful interfering in departmentoperations if the person prevents department employees from carryingout duties authorized by this title, including but not limited tointerfering: (a) In the operation of department vehicles, vessels, or aircraft; (b) With the inspection of fish, wildlife, and shellfish taken orpossessed in the field or stored at a facility open for commercialpurposes; (c) With the collection of samples of tissue, fluids, or otherbodily parts of fish, wildlife, and shellfish; (d) In the boarding of vessels engaged in recreational orcommercial harvest of fish or shellfish. (2) Unlawful interfering in department operations is a grossmisdemeanor.
